title: Original Anime Hero
theme: Design the hero of an anime that doesn't exist yet
description:
Create the key art for a brand-new anime protagonist of your own: a character sheet, a key visual or a full illustration. Show us who they are, what world they live in and what makes their story worth watching.

Any 2D medium: digital painting, cel shading, line art, watercolour scans. One image per entrant.
prize: Cash prize for 1st place (amount announced at launch) + featured on the anime.support home page

title: Mecha or Magic: 3D Character
theme: An original pilot, mecha or magical fighter, modelled in 3D
description:
Sculpt or model an original anime-style character: a mecha pilot, the mecha itself, or a magical fighter in full outfit.

Upload a GLB file (people can spin it in 3D right on the page), or a turntable video or rendered image. Keep it under 25 MB.
prize: Cash prize for 1st place (amount announced at launch) + featured on the anime.support home page

title: Neon Shrine at Night: 3D Environment
theme: A shrine, alley or rooftop in an anime city after dark
description:
Build an anime-style environment where old and new collide: a shrine between skyscrapers, a rainy alley, a rooftop at midnight.

Upload a GLB scene, a fly-through video or your best render (under 25 MB).
prize: Cash prize for 1st place (amount announced at launch) + featured on the anime.support home page

title: Five-Second Sakuga
theme: A short original animation loop with real impact
description:
Animate up to 15 seconds of original action: a punch, a transformation, a run cycle with personality, an effects shot. 2D, 3D or mixed.

Upload MP4 or WebM, under 25 MB.
prize: Cash prize for 1st place (amount announced at launch) + featured on the anime.support home page
